| B26 Current residential address | ADDRESS_P1 |
| B27 Telephone | PHONE_P1 |
| B27 Mobile number | NEEDS-YOU |
| B28 Email | NEEDS-YOU |
| B29 Current occupation and position | Software engineer |
| B30 Employer name | NEEDS-YOU |
| B30 Employer telephone | NEEDS-YOU |
| B31 Employer address | NEEDS-YOU |
| B32 Partner’s occupation | Pharmacist |

After the values are restored, put both B02 names in the single given-and-middle-names blank in passport order. Format B04 and B14 as day/month/year. Put B05 in city, state or province, and country order, adding any missing components from your records. Add any other current residential addresses to B26. If the number in B27 is your mobile, put it in the Mobile No. blank and add a separate telephone number if applicable.

For B03 and B09, confirm whether you have any other names or former or additional nationalities to report. Use your records to complete B10, confirm the passport category for B11, and check the place of issue for B13. For B17, check whether you have a Certificate of Eligibility number to enter.

Confirm whether B33 and B34 apply to your trip. If your inviter and guarantor are the same person, write “same as above” in B34.
